title: PERCEPTION DETERMINES REALITY
subtitle: Human-Mediated Causal Egress and Authority-Presentation Extension

new_primitives.HUMAN_AUTHORITY_ENVELOPE: Human-visible provenance and authority metadata attached to consequential output.
new_primitives.HUMAN_MEDIATED_EFFECT_RECEIPT: Optional record that a human reports or a downstream system observes an action influenced by a Janus output.
new_primitives.ENFORCEMENT_CEILING: Explicit statement of where cryptographic/tool enforcement ends and autonomous human judgment begins.

core_rule: Human-mediated causality requires provenance and clear authority presentation, but must not pretend that a free human recipient is a fenceable machine actuator.
presentation_contract: bind COMMITTED_INSTRUCTION to exact COMMIT_ID when applicable
do not style ADVISORY as if it were a host command
preserve action scope and provenance reference
state when the system cannot enforce or verify the recipient's downstream action
causal_model: JANUS_STATE -> OUTPUT_CLASSIFIED_WITH_PROVENANCE -> HUMAN_INTERPRETATION -> HUMAN_CHOICE -> WORLD_EFFECT -> OPTIONAL_EFFECT_RECEIPT
verification_requirements: stale output rendered with stale/unverified status
advisory output cannot carry a forged committed-instruction marker in the reference UI/schema
committed instruction resolves to current commit provenance
human-mediated path is listed in causal surface inventory
system does not claim prevention of voluntary human action
canonical_lines: Where machine enforcement ends, authority presentation must become explicit.
A human can be informed by Janus without becoming Janus's actuator.
Causal influence should be recorded without erasing independent human agency.
